63403.description:
Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
synonyms: แมวสาวอมควัน

63409.description:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)
synonyms: Hi, I'm a Witch, and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion
I'm a witch who's crush requested a love potion

title.english: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
title.native: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
title.romaji: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.

63411.description:
Short directed by Sunao Katabuchi in collaboration with Fukushima Prefecture's general information magazine Fukushima Map's Supporter Association to promote the appeal of the prefecture to more people.

“A mysterious journey through Fukushima.”

New short animated film by Sunao Katabuchi, “Fukufuku no Chizu.”

(Source: Official Website, translated)

63413.description:
Second season of Jikuu wo Koeta Energy no Tabi.

Tetsurou and Maetel embark on an energy journey through time and space and visit several planets with varying circumstances.

title.native: 銀河鉄道999～時空を越えたエネルギーの旅～season.2
title.romaji: Ginga Tetsudou 999: Jikuu wo Koeta Energy no Tabi season.2

63414.description: Ai Nina’s first original animated short film telling the story of Nene, a student who encounters a mysterious shapeshifting being named Luca.

63415.description:
Lele, a white dog, and Xiaoliang, a gray one-eyed cat, run a struggling convenience store. Besides selling goods, they also take on commissions to earn money. The story follows Lele and Xiaoliang as they complete various tasks, experiencing a series of small adventures together—stories about courage, understanding, and learning how to love and be loved.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

63416.description:
The story unfolds in a fantastical martial arts world where ordinary people can unleash their mental and physical potential through continuous martial arts practice and internal energy cultivation. The protagonist, Lin Chen, is an ordinary martial artist of humble origins who strives for the pinnacle of skill. After experiencing injustice, his anger triggers his inner mental potential, entering a state of "Mind Awareness" similar to a quantum effect. However, this also allows him to witness the terrible danger his family faces in the future. Therefore, to protect his family and loved ones from fatal harm and to investigate the mystery of his father's disappearance, Lin Chen uses a mysterious list as a clue to uncover the truth behind everything, engaging in a perilous and arduous struggle against evil forces, thus weaving a legendary and moving tale

(Source: Youku, translated)

title.english: Dragon's Triumph in the Celestial Realm

63418.description:
Three ordinary schoolboys come into possession of a DVD that supposedly opens a gateway to a parallel universe, but when their backs are turned Pyontaro's little sister Futaba passes through and gets kidnapped by the aliens that have overrun that version of Earth! Discovering that their cartoonish bodies make them supermen in the hyper-realistic parallel universe, the boys set out to rescue Futaba.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

63419.description:
In this brand-new spinoff of the runaway hit series, Iruma is a dirt-poor but kind young boy who grows up in a ruthless city slum. One day, Iruma gives a severely injured old man his last loaf of bread and nurses the stranger back to health—only to find out that the elder gent is none other than Don Sullivan, leader of the Babel Mafia! Soon after, Don Sullivan comes back, whisks Iruma away, and begs the boy to become his grandson. And just like that, the curtains rise on Iruma’s chaotic new life as the next in line to a gigantic gang of—dare we saydemonic mafiosos!

(Source: Kodansha USA)
synonyms: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun: IruMafia Edition

title.native: 魔入りました！入間くん if Episode of 魔フィア
title.romaji: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun: If Episode of Mafia

63423.description:
The story centers on a boy named Kazuki Tsukigase, who transfers to a high school on a remote island to get away from anyone who knows him. Kazuki finds out that there is an inlet on the island where people are rumored to disappear. Exploring the inlet, he encounters an unconscious girl. When she comes to after Kazuki takes her to the clinic, she is unable to give out anything about her identity except that she is named Nao, is 16 years old, and whispers the year "1974."

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
title.romaji: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e

63424.description:
A couple thousand years of solitude would wear down any young man—that is, anyone except Asley, an eternally youthful and eternally foolish sorcerer. After all, he has man's best friend...er, familiar, to keep him company. When his Level 100 canine companion Pochi demands that he get some fresh air for the first time in two centuries, Asley sets out to reintegrate into society and test his magic mettle. His mission? Dropping several unglamorous titles from his repertoire and restoring his good (okay, decent) name.

A brand-new world and fresh adventures await Asley after his many years of hermitage. Perhaps he'll lend Pochi a hand to place first in the mysterious Familiar Feud. Or maybe he'll lose all vestiges of dignity and turn tail. Whichever comes first! No matter what, Asley has great evil to fight, a big world to save, and even a little growing up to do...that is, if he can endure Pochi's “friendly advice” along the way!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Eternal Fool's Words of Wisdom: A Pawsitively Fantastic Adventure
title.native: 悠久の愚者アズリーの、賢者のすゝめ
title.romaji: Yuukyuu no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume

63427.description:
A chance encounter between young Tang Zhi and a dragon maiden unexpectedly awakened his "Heavenly Eye"—allowing him to see gods and spirits roaming the mortal realm. These unique eyes led him into a world that coexisted with the mundane. Through unforgettable experiences, Tang Zhi made friends with all sorts of people and experienced laughter and warmth in seemingly ordinary yet subtly wondrous daily moments. An ordinary scholar, encountering and accompanying a group of gods and spirits with diverse personalities amidst the everyday life of the mortal world—this story of adventure, friendship, and growth is slowly unfolding.

(Source: Bangumi, translated)

63428.description: The thirty-second season of Xi Yangyang Yu Hui Tailang.

title.native: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之古古怪界有古怪
title.romaji: Xi Yangyang Yu Hui Tailang: Gu Guguai Jie You Guguai

63431.description:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.

Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.

The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.

Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.

This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!

(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)
synonyms: The Exiled Cheating Magician Enjoys an Unrestrained Second Life.: I Can Give "Strengthening Points" Not Only to Weapons, But Also to Everything, and I Can Unlock the Effect at Any Time of My Will, But are the Rest Okay?
The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a New Life

title.english: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
title.native: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
title.romaji: Tsuihou Sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka Suru.: Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?

63433.description:
The story follows Riddle, a young man who lost his companions to a mysterious group known as the "Box of Malice." On the brink of despair, after 1,000 years, Riddle eventually achieves the ability to reverse time. With a thousand years of knowledge and experience, the Great Sage Riddle journeys to the past.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: The Great Sage Riddle's Time Reversal
การย้อนเวลาของมหาปราชญ์ริดเดิล

title.native: 大賢者リドルの時間逆行

63439.description:
Forced into a marriage of convenience based on mutual benefit, Jiang Yuan, an assassin from the Tai Xuan Tower, and Shao Yue, the holy maiden of the Jiu Xuan Sect, are ordered to marry. On their wedding night, they attempt an assassination, only to discover they are both immortal. To obtain the Demon-Suppressing Bell and the Demon-Controlling Bell, secret treasures of each other's sects, they transform from mortal enemies into a facade of marriage, engaging in a charade of mutual deception. However, neither is aware that the other is also an alien survivor whose home was destroyed by the "Void." This destined couple forms an alliance amidst suspicion and testing, not only searching for the treasures transformed from a lost spaceship but also confronting the ever-watchful cultivation world, seeking hope to defeat the "Void" amidst perilous circumstances.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

63442.description: The sixth season of Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka.
synonyms: It Wrong To Try To Pick Up Girls in a Dungeon? VI

title.native: ダンジョンに出会いを求めるのは間違っているだろうかⅤI
title.romaji: Dungeon ni Deai wo Motomeru no wa Machigatteiru Darou ka VI

63459.description: A "dark veil" suddenly appears in the real world, prompting the little fairies to return to the Realm of Illusion to investigate. It turns out that the Realm of Illusion is being rebuilt, and Nightfall, along with her mysterious agents and the Dark Stars, has returned, attempting to dominate the magical world.
synonyms: Balala the Fairies: Radiant Star Guardians 2nd Season

title.native: 巴啦啦小魔仙之曜星守护者2
title.romaji: Balala Xiao Mo Xian: Yao Xing Shouhu Zhe 2

63468.description:
This exorcism is OMFFFFFFFFF!!!! Shizuka is a self-proclaimed ordinary high school girl who "only" sees ghosts. Using her unique ability to attract spirits, she works as an assistant to the famous psychic, Kamui. Though Kamui boasts overwhelming spiritual power, his exorcism methods are unprecedented...?! Will Shizuka, tossed about by supernatural disturbances, ever find peace? The curtain rises on "supreme" exorcism!! OMFFFFFFFFFG ALMIGHTY!!

(Source: OceanVeil)
synonyms: คุณคามุยลุยหลังผี

title.native: うしろの正面カムイさん

63469.description:
Ritsu inherited his sixth sense from his grandfather, along with a demon guardian named Blue Storm. Strange things just seem to happen around these two, and it's left to them to get to the bottom of all these mysterious events. Each story is independent but features recurring characters you'll come to know and appreciate as they, each in their own way, try to deal with things 'not of this world'.

(Source: MU)
synonyms: Tales of a Hundred Ghosts Traveling by the Night
บันทึกขบวนร้อยอสูรแห่งรัตติกาล

63472.description:
On rainy days, Hina has dreams about her younger self playing with a mysterious boy in a garden she's never seen before—until, by chance, she stumbles upon the place. There's a young man there, Takaaki, who mistakes Hina for his fiancée Hinako. He whisks her back to what he thinks is her home, where Hina's doppelganger is waiting, and Hina realizes this isn't the Tokyo she left behind but Japan in the year 1907! Is this all a dream or something much stranger?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

63476.description:
After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession..!
Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a Yandere.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: The Final-Boss Prince is Somehow Obsessed with the Chubby Villainess: Reincarnated Me
When I Reincarnated as a Chubby Villainess, For Some Reason, I'm Being Relentlessly Pursued by the Final Boss Prince!

title.native: おデブ悪女に転生したら、なぜかラスボス王子様に執着されています
title.romaji: Odebu Akujo ni Tensei Shitara, Naze ka Last Boss Ouji-sama ni Shuuchaku Sareteimasu

63485.description:
The modern world is a stage for superheroes, or should we say it was, until the Master of Heavenly God Sect accidentally appeared in NY City. Everything will be different from now on. The game is on but the rules are going to change. One by one, the superheroes are defeated by this strange "young" man. Who is this mysterious cultivator? Is he the biggest villain in centuries or an invincible savior in the new era...

(Source: MangaToon)

63489.description:
After a mysterious hand drags her beneath a puddle, modern Japanese teenager Yuri awakens in the Hittite Empire of the 14th century BCE. Thrust into a deadly struggle for the throne, she joins Prince Kail to battle assassins, outwit royal conspiracies, and survive a world at war. As her exploits earn her renown as the goddess Ishtar, Yuri must choose between her old life and an uncertain future.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title.romaji: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori

63493.description: Music video directed by Hideki Nagamachi for the song Dou-Da? DOING! by IKIZULIVE!
63493.hashtag: #イキヅライブ #いきづらい部
